research_mode: official Police.uk API documentation only; stop-search field and location semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Stop-search location approximation
verified_claims: stop-search coordinates are approximate
published coordinates are not exact stop locations
limitations: must not be used as parcel coordinates

sources.name: Stop-search location identifier
verified_claims: location_id selects a published location
date can restrict the response to YYYY-MM
limitations: location_id identifies an anonymised map point

sources.name: Stop-search default month
verified_claims: date is optional
the latest month is returned by default
limitations: latest is source availability, not current-day data

sources.name: Stop-search type values
verified_claims: type distinguishes person, vehicle, or person-and-vehicle search
limitations: type is not an outcome or severity field

sources.name: Derived involved-person flag
verified_claims: involved_person is derived from type
it is true for every type except vehicle search
limitations: derived flag must not be treated as independently supplied evidence

sources.name: Stop-search timestamp
verified_claims: datetime records when the search took place

sources.name: Date-only midnight concentration
verified_claims: some forces provide only dates
date-only supply can create disproportionate midnight timestamps
limitations: midnight must not automatically be interpreted as actual event time

sources.name: Policing-operation flag
verified_claims: operation indicates whether the search was part of a policing operation
limitations: null or false must remain distinct where supplied

sources.name: Policing-operation name
verified_claims: operation_name contains the operation name when supplied
limitations: missing name does not prove no operation

sources.name: Stop-search gender field
verified_claims: gender is returned when applicable and provided
limitations: missing gender must not be inferred

sources.name: Stop-search age range
verified_claims: age_range represents age at the time of the stop
limitations: banded age is not exact age

sources.name: Self-defined ethnicity
verified_claims: self_defined_ethnicity is the stopped person's self-defined category
limitations: must remain separate from officer-defined ethnicity

sources.name: Officer-defined ethnicity
verified_claims: officer_defined_ethnicity is the officer-assigned category
limitations: must not be substituted for self-defined ethnicity

sources.name: Stop-search legal power
verified_claims: legislation identifies the power used for the search
limitations: null legislation must not be guessed

sources.name: Object of search
verified_claims: object_of_search states the reason the search was carried out
limitations: reason is not proof that an object was found
